verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches migration. The Draft Issuer API can create issuers (carta-docs-33), draft option grants can be created programmatically (carta-docs-22), and partners can send new customers to Carta (carta-docs-12). A community report says private-company onboarding exists but is an involved, fee-bearing process documented across dozens of help articles (carta-comm-9). missing for 10: a documented guided import from spreadsheets or other platforms, import validation, reconciliation against source documents, and any hands-on corroboration of the migration workflow.
